title: Algolia Search
description: Configure your Algolia account credentials. Find these in your Algolia dashboard under API Keys.

appId.label: Application ID
appId.help: Your Algolia Application ID — shown in the dashboard as 'Application ID'.

adminApiKey.label: Admin API Key
adminApiKey.help: Used for indexing content. KEEP SECRET — anyone with this key can modify your Algolia data.

searchApiKey.label: Search-Only API Key
searchApiKey.help: Used for querying. Safe to expose in client-side code (eventually — not used by T3 directly).

indexName.label: Index Name
indexName.help: Name of the Algolia index that holds T3 content. Defaults to tcms_content; change if you share an Algolia account with other apps.
